name: Mud & Hound Public Company Limited
summary: Mud & Hound Public Company Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the retail of food and beverages across Thailand and on an international scale. The firm's operations are bifurcated into two main divisions: Food and Beverage, and Garment. Within the Food and Beverage segment, the company handles the production and distribution of snacks, various drinks, and ice cream, alongside managing its restaurant ventures. Conversely, the Garment segment concentrates on the manufacturing and sale of apparel and leather goods. Mud & Hound acts as an authorized franchisee for well-known establishments such as Au Bon Pain bakery café, Baskin Robbins, and Dunkin' Donuts. Additionally, it boasts a collection of proprietary brands, which include Greyhound Café, M Kitchen, Funky Fries, Le Grand Véfour, Pasco, Augustin, A Noste, Another Hound Café, and Baan Hound. Established in 2006, the company was originally named Mudman Public Company Limited, adopting its current name in June 2021. Headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, Mud & Hound Public Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sub Sri Thai Public Company Limited.
